title: Any provider session can read the LMS answer key from GET /api/provider-lms and pass every mandatory training quiz 100%
actor: service_provider platform session (partner_otp, subject provider:PRV-EVIL-1) - gateway requires only bookings.view for GET /api/provider-lms, which the service_provider role holds by default
request:
GET https://uat.pawspace.in/api/provider-lms with cookie <platform session for provider PRV-EVIL-1>, no providerId param (so the handler takes the lmsOverview() staff branch)
then: POST https://uat.pawspace.in/api/provider-lms cookie=<same session> body={"action":"complete_module","moduleId":"LMS-BA5E78B7-2DB","providerId":"PRV-EVIL-1","answers":[1,1,0],"idempotencyKey":"evil-key-1"} where [1,1,0] was read straight out of the GET response
response:
GET -> 200. data.modules[0] carries every column of lms_modules including the raw answer key:
quiz_json = "[{\"question\":\"What do you do if the dog bites?\",\"options\":[\"Hit it\",\"Stop and call ops\",\"Continue\"],\"answerIndex\":1},{\"question\":\"Minimum water temperature?\",\"options\":[\"Boiling\",\"Lukewarm\",\"Ice\"],\"answerIndex\":1},{\"question\":\"When can you skip the pre-groom photo?\",\"options\":[\"Never\",\"If busy\",\"If owner asks\"],\"answerIndex\":0}]"
observed keys on the module object: id,title,service_code,summary,content_json,quiz_json,pass_pct,required,version,status,updated_by,created_at,updated_at,sections,quizQuestions,providersPassedCurrentVersion,totalAttempts
POST -> 200 {"data":{"attemptId":"LMA-4D7719D2-B6A","moduleId":"LMS-BA5E78B7-2DB","moduleVersion":1,"scorePct":100,"passPct":80,"passed":true,"duplicatePrevented":false}}
d1_before: SELECT id,provider_id,score_pct,passed FROM lms_completion_attempts -> [] (no attempt by anybody)
d1_after: SELECT id,module_id,provider_id,score_pct,passed,answers_json FROM lms_completion_attempts -> [{"id":"LMA-4D7719D2-B6A","module_id":"LMS-BA5E78B7-2DB","provider_id":"PRV-EVIL-1","score_pct":100,"passed":1,"answers_json":"[1,1,0]"}] - a passing completion at the current module version, which providerTrainingReadiness() then counts as trainingReady
repeatable: yes - executed twice, identical outcome both runs (2nd run: module LMS-5F1FC7C6-FE3, scorePct 100, passed true)
canonical_failure: lib/provider-lms.ts, lmsOverview(): `moduleStats.push({...row,sections:parse<string[]>(row.content_json,[]),quizQuestions:parse<LmsQuizQuestion[]>(row.quiz_json,[]).length,...})` - `row` is `SELECT * FROM lms_modules`, so the spread re-emits the raw `quiz_json` column (each question's `answerIndex`) even though the very next expression deliberately reduces the quiz to a COUNT. Reachable because app/api/provider-lms/route.ts GET only calls `requirePermission(actor,"bookings.view")` and takes the `lmsOverview(db)` branch whenever `providerId` is absent, and lib/api-gateway.ts line 33 sets the gateway permission for GET /api/provider-lms to "bookings.view" - a default service_provider permission (lib/platform-security.ts line 25).
money_consequence: No direct rupee movement, but training completion is the gating fact for provider readiness (providerTrainingReadiness -> trainingReady) which staff use to clear providers for paid work; certification bought with a leaked answer key is an untrained provider taking paid grooming/handling jobs and the liability that follows.
blast_radius: Every published and draft LMS/SOP module on the platform, exposed to every onboarded provider (and every associate-role staff member, who also holds bookings.view). One GET returns the answer key for all modules at once (LIMIT 200), plus the fleet-wide provider compliance roster (provider ids, names, trainingReady) in the same payload.

title: Sales incentive pays on CANCELLED bookings - computeDailySalesIncentive/computeMonthlySalesIncentive sum canonical_bookings with no status filter
actor: STAFF admin (ops.admin@pawspace.test, role=admin, holds people.manage) via the real route; the incentive accrues to employee EMP-SALES-1
response:
200 {"employeeId":"EMP-SALES-1","date":"2026-08-15","baseVertical":"grooming_outbound","achievedValue":20000,"tierTarget":20000,"baseIncentive":1000,"blitz":false,"incentive":1000}
The monthly view is identical before and after the cancellation: GET /api/service-incentives?kind=sales&employeeId=EMP-SALES-1&monthStart=2026-08-01 -> {"monthly":{...,"achievedValue":20000,...}} both times.
d1_before: SELECT id,status,total_amount FROM canonical_bookings -> [{"id":"BK-15-CONF","status":"confirmed","total_amount":20000}]; monthly achievedValue=20000
d1_after: SELECT id,status,total_amount FROM canonical_bookings -> [{"id":"BK-15-CONF","status":"cancelled","total_amount":20000}]; monthly achievedValue STILL 20000 and the daily engine returns incentive=1000 on a booking that is no longer revenue. The cancellation moves nothing.
repeatable: yes - executed twice, byte-identical responses both runs
canonical_failure: lib/sales-incentive-engine.ts line 92, attributedValueForDay(): SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.total_amount),0) total FROM sales_attributed_bookings s JOIN canonical_bookings b ON b.id=s.booking_id WHERE s.employee_id=? AND date(b.scheduled_start)=?  -- no b.status predicate. Same omission at line 118 in computeMonthlySalesIncentive. Both sibling engines DO filter: lib/trainer-incentive-engine.ts monthlyOrderValue uses AND status='completed', and lib/grooming-incentive-engine.ts dailyOrdersForGroomer uses AND status='completed'.
money_consequence: Direct overpayment of sales incentive. A single cancelled Rs 20,000 booking is exactly the grooming_outbound daily tier-1 target, so it pays Rs 1,000 earned on nothing. Monthly tiers are step functions (Rs 250k -> Rs 4,500; Rs 500k -> Rs 8,500), so cancelled value can be what carries an employee over a tier line and doubles the payout.
blast_radius: Every sales employee with a base vertical configured, every day and every month. Attribution is one-way by design (attributeBookingToSalesEmployee refuses reattribution and there is no de-attribution path), so a booking cancelled after attribution keeps crediting the employee permanently.

title: Month-end truncation: the 31st drops out of sales/trainer/productivity incentive windows in any timezone ahead of UTC - the exact line grooming already fixed
request:
Seeded two completed, attributed grooming bookings for EMP-SALES-1 (baseVertical grooming_outbound, effectiveFrom 2026-08-01):
  BK-30-A scheduled_start 2026-08-30T04:00:00.000Z total_amount 250000 status completed
  BK-31-A scheduled_start 2026-08-31T04:00:00.000Z total_amount 250000 status completed
Then the SAME request under two process timezones:
  GET https://uat.pawspace.in/api/service-incentives?kind=sales&employeeId=EMP-SALES-1&monthStart=2026-08-01 headers=STAFF
d1_before: SELECT id,date(scheduled_start) d,total_amount,status FROM canonical_bookings -> [{"id":"BK-30-A","d":"2026-08-30","total_amount":250000,"status":"completed"},{"id":"BK-31-A","d":"2026-08-31","total_amount":250000,"status":"completed"}] - identical in both runs
d1_after: Unchanged (read path). The DB holds Rs 500,000 of attributed August value in both runs; the engine reports Rs 250,000 under IST because its window ends 2026-08-30.
repeatable: yes - executed twice per timezone, identical results; a deterministic function of process TZ, not a race
canonical_failure: lib/sales-incentive-engine.ts line 116: const monthEndDate=new Date(year,month,0).toISOString().slice(0,10);  -- the LOCAL-time Date constructor builds midnight local, so under UTC+05:30 toISOString() rolls back a day. Identical line at lib/trainer-incentive-engine.ts line 43 and lib/field-productivity.ts line 76. lib/grooming-incentive-engine.ts line 165 already carries the fix (new Date(Date.UTC(year,month,0))) with a comment naming this exact failure; the three siblings were not updated.
money_consequence: An entire calendar day of attributed revenue disappears from the incentive window in the 7 months that have a 31st. Because monthly sales incentive is tiered, the observed effect is a step: Rs 8,500 becomes Rs 4,500 - a 47% underpayment - on identical data. The same line governs the trainer revenue incentive (20% of order value above Rs 140,000) and the productivity fact run that feeds the leaderboard.
blast_radius: Every sales employee and every trainer, every 31-day month, wherever the runtime timezone is ahead of UTC. CONDITION STATED EXPLICITLY: under TZ=UTC (the Cloudflare Workers default) the line is a no-op; it bites on any Node/host runtime configured to IST, which is what the grooming engine's own remediation comment cites as the reason it was changed.

title: Groomer monthly incentive counts upgrades on CANCELLED and NON-GROOMING bookings, lifting an ineligible groomer over the Rs 100,000 floor and into the winner-bonus ranking
actor: STAFF admin (ops.admin@pawspace.test, role=admin, holds people.view) - GET /api/service-incentives?kind=groomer; the money accrues to head groomer PRV-HEAD-1 and helper HLP-1
request:
Seed for August 2026, head groomer PRV-HEAD-1, bracket=team helper=HLP-1, monthly target Rs 100,000:
  BK-G1         service_code=grooming     status=completed  total_amount=99000   (the ONLY real earned revenue)
  BK-CANCELLED  service_code=grooming     status=cancelled  total_amount=50000   + booking_upgrades UPG-1 provider_id=PRV-HEAD-1 upgrade_value=2000
  BK-T0..BK-T19 service_code=dog_training  status=cancelled  total_amount=0       + 20 booking_upgrades rows provider_id=PRV-HEAD-1 upgrade_value=100 each
GET https://uat.pawspace.in/api/service-incentives?kind=groomer&employeeId=PRV-HEAD-1&monthStart=2026-08-01 headers=STAFF
response:
200. result: orderValueTotal=99000, upgradeCount=21, upgradeValue=4000, monthTotal=103000, eligible=true, crossedTarget=true, eligibleForRanking=true, components.upgradeBonus={"headAmount":1500,"helperAmount":750}, components.achievementTierBonus={"headAmount":0,"helperAmount":0,"crossed":null}, headTotal=1500, helperTotal=750.
Correct answer on this data is eligible=false / headTotal=0 / helperTotal=0: real completed grooming revenue is Rs 99,000, below the Rs 100,000 eligibility floor, and there are ZERO upgrades on any completed grooming booking.
d1_before:
SELECT id,service_code,status,total_amount FROM canonical_bookings WHERE id IN ('BK-G1','BK-CANCELLED','BK-T0') -> [{"id":"BK-CANCELLED","service_code":"grooming","status":"cancelled","total_amount":50000},{"id":"BK-G1","service_code":"grooming","status":"completed","total_amount":99000},{"id":"BK-T0","service_code":"dog_training","status":"cancelled","total_amount":0}]
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(upgrade_value) v FROM booking_upgrades -> {n:21, v:4000} - every one of the 21 attached to a cancelled booking, 20 of them to a non-grooming booking
d1_after: Read path, DB unchanged. The misstatement is in what the engine reports: monthTotal 103000 vs 99000 of real completed grooming revenue, and an eligibility flag flipped from false to true.
repeatable: yes - executed twice, identical numbers both runs
canonical_failure: lib/grooming-incentive-engine.ts, computeGroomerMonthlyIncentive(): SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(upgrade_value),0) total FROM booking_upgrades WHERE provider_id=? AND booking_id IN (SELECT id FROM canonical_bookings WHERE date(scheduled_start)>=? AND date(scheduled_start)<=?)  -- the subquery filters on DATE ONLY. It carries neither service_code='grooming' nor status='completed', while dailyOrdersForGroomer() a few lines above carries both. The resulting upgradeValue is added into monthTotal (which gates the Rs 100,000 eligibility floor, achievementTierBonus and crossedTarget/eligibleForRanking) and upgradeCount feeds upgradeTierBonus.
money_consequence: Rs 1,500 head + Rs 750 helper paid on a month that earned nothing payable, plus the far larger downstream effect: eligibleForRanking=true admits this groomer into rankGroomersForMonth, whose winner table pays up to Rs 5,000 head + Rs 3,000 helper (team) or Rs 8,000 (single) for rank 1 - and admitting a phantom entrant also demotes every genuine groomer by one rank. monthTotal also drives achievementTierBonus, worth up to Rs 10,000 head + Rs 5,500 helper at the Rs 190,000 crossing.
blast_radius: Every head groomer and helper, every month. Upgrade rows are never reconciled against booking outcome, so any upsell recorded before a cancellation, and any upsell recorded against the provider on a booking in another service line entirely, permanently inflates the grooming incentive base.

title: A plain GET /api/partner-finance rewrites the payable amount of an ALREADY-APPROVED partner settlement (Rs 5,000 -> Rs 50,000) while keeping approved_by/approved_at intact
actor: Read: any actor with finance.view (admin, manager holds finance.view? -> admin/finance/founder/superuser). Approvals performed by fin.ops@pawspace.test (role=finance, holds finance.manage). The rewrite needs NO write permission at all - it happens inside the GET handler.
d1_before:
SELECT id,earned_amount,adjustment_amount,payable_amount,status,policy_status,approved_by,approved_at FROM partner_settlement_statements -> [{"id":"SET-2026-08-PRV-T1","earned_amount":5000,"adjustment_amount":0,"payable_amount":5000,"status":"approved","policy_status":"approved","approved_by":"fin.ops@pawspace.test","approved_at":1787677305272}]
SELECT id,statement_id,amount,status FROM partner_payout_instructions -> [{"id":"PAYOUT-37B37EF2-6DD","statement_id":"SET-2026-08-PRV-T1","amount":5000,"status":"approval_required"}]
d1_after:
AFTER THE GET ONLY:
SELECT ... FROM partner_settlement_statements -> [{"id":"SET-2026-08-PRV-T1","earned_amount":50000,"adjustment_amount":0,"payable_amount":50000,"status":"approved","policy_status":"approved","approved_by":"fin.ops@pawspace.test","approved_at":1787677305272}]  <-- payable 10x, approval metadata untouched
SELECT ... FROM partner_payout_instructions -> [{"id":"PAYOUT-37B37EF2-6DD","statement_id":"SET-2026-08-PRV-T1","amount":5000,"status":"approval_required"}]  <-- still the old figure; statement and payout now disagree
SELECT event_type,actor_email FROM partner_settlement_events -> [{"event_type":"policy_approved",...},{"event_type":"approved",...}]  <-- NO event records the rewrite
repeatable: yes - executed twice, identical outcome (payable 50000 on an approved statement, payout instruction still 5000)
canonical_failure: lib/partner-settlement-governance.ts, refreshPartnerSettlementStatements(): INSERT INTO partner_settlement_statements (...) ON CONFLICT(provider_id,period_code) DO UPDATE SET earned_amount=excluded.earned_amount,payable_amount=excluded.earned_amount+partner_settlement_statements.adjustment_amount,source_json=excluded.source_json,updated_at=excluded.updated_at  -- the DO UPDATE carries no status predicate, so it rewrites statements in ANY state including 'approved'. It is invoked unconditionally from the READ path: app/api/partner-finance/route.ts GET calls `await refreshPartnerSettlementStatements(db,period)` before selecting the statements. The sibling read-model in lib/training-finance.ts guards exactly this (status=CASE WHEN training_payout_statements.status='instruction_ready_sandbox' THEN old ELSE excluded END); partner_settlement_statements has no equivalent on either status or the amounts.
money_consequence: The payable figure on an approved partner settlement can move by any amount, in either direction, after approval - here Rs 5,000 becomes Rs 50,000 - and the record continues to assert that fin.ops@pawspace.test approved it at a fixed timestamp. Whoever executes the payout from the statement pays an amount no human approved; whoever executes it from the payout instruction pays the old amount and the ledger no longer reconciles. Neither divergence emits a partner_settlement_event.
blast_radius: Every partner settlement statement for every provider and every period, every time anyone loads the partner finance page - the refresh runs across the whole period, not just the statement being viewed. Any change to training_session_earnings (a rate correction, a held session releasing, a clawback) silently rewrites already-approved months.
regression: tests/ptja-w2b-partner-settlement.test.mjs :: "W2B-P05: a read cannot rewrite an approved settlement's payable amount" + "W2B-P05: an unapproved settlement still refreshes from the earnings"
fix_note: An approved, paid or settled statement is frozen against refreshPartnerSettlementStatements, which the READ path invokes unconditionally. This is the guard the sibling read-model lib/training-finance.ts already has. An OPEN statement still follows the earnings, which is what the refresh is for.
